Community Manager

You will grow and look after our Discord and forum communities, run events and bring the voice of the
community back to the product team. The role suits someone who enjoys teaching and storytelling.

What you will do day to day:
- Moderate and welcome new members
- Plan two community events a month
- Collect feedback for product and engineering
- Write the weekly community newsletter
- Work with developer relations on content
- Track community health metrics
- Support the team during launches
- Manage a small budget for swag

Requirements
- Experience running an online community
- Excellent writing

Job details
Location: Remote
Work type: Remote
Type: Part-time
Pay rate: $28 - $34 per hour
